Next-session suggestions

Based on your log

Uses the latest session for each exercise. Default: 3 recorded sets at the same weight, all at 8+ reps (15+ for calf raises). Include all working sets; warm-ups and mixed loads may need your judgment. Suggestions never change your workout automatically.

Increase only when technique and recovery feel good. Use the smallest available increment. These are simple log-based rules, not an AI assessment.

Progress rules

For most exercises, build toward 8 clean reps on every planned working set; calf raises use a 15-rep target. Suggestions require at least 3 logged sets at one weight. Your chart uses only recorded sessions, not suggested starting weights.
